answer: Locks are recorded in spiral, expire in garden, and nectar lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 73 aliases therefore needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 159 dollars in locked collateral and another 10 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
